discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in c8b9737. `handlePonytailCommands()` now accepts `sourceFormatOverride` and `streamOverride` and uses them when present instead of always re-deriving format/stream from the raw body.

True, and worse than it looks: if the client registered its own tool under this reserved name, the interceptor would execute the client's tool as if it were a search. Fixed in a4e8066. The conversion now checks the outgoing tool names first and skips the whole rewrite (body returned unchanged) when the name is already taken. Test added.
Fixed in 46ebf215: the Responses probe now accepts 2xx plus explicit transient statuses (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504). It rejects 405, 410, and 422; focused tests cover these cases.
